scope: Tracked .js files under src/ and public/ only; excludes tooling, .mjs, inline scripts and dependency directories. Counts are inventory, not effort or behavior coverage.
classification: Generated outputs come from explicit build manifests. Vendor bundles reside under public/vendor. Module forwarders contain only imports/exports/empty statements, verified with the TypeScript parser; targets may still be JavaScript. All other files remain candidates requiring manual dependency/risk review.
